Mars landers · Launched 1975
The first successful US Mars landers. They sent pictures and tested soil for signs of life.
Not operational · ended 1980 and 1982
Where it is now: still on Mars, exactly where they touched down.

A story page
Mars · Part 3 · Spirit
The Traveller Who Refused to Give Up
I was one half of a pair.
My twin was called Opportunity, and together we were sent to investigate the history of water on Mars.
I was finding pieces of a forgotten history.
My mission was originally designed to last approximately 90 Martian days.
Ninety.

The ending

Impact, AI disclosure and the site
Impact
Giving voices to machines that went offline for good.
Not everything was in vain: their sacrifices made us progress.
AI disclosure
BMTL wrote part of the text, supplied the NASA pictures and checked the facts.
Claude (Anthropic) built the site and drafted the rest of the story in first person.
GitHub Copilot fixed file issues. ChatGPT drafted a Mars story idea.
